data.every_bonus: Permanent — the two Awakes become one permanent that stays when the channel ends and adds the target's Stat to yours: an awakened ally's Will, a moved building's stat bonus (yourself or a wall lend nothing).
data.text: Move yourself, an ally in contact, a building or a wall token (obstacle, labyrinth wall) within 2 hexes to a free hex within 10: click the hex (the thing that gains most goes there), or click the thing (it goes to its best hex); with no click the most beneficial move. Channel: a Harmony token on your tile every action until contact with an enemy.

logic.description: Implemented 2026-10-29, reworked 2026-11-17 (user: clicking a tile while casting moves the nearby building / ally / me there; no click → the most beneficial position). The resolver (game/awake.mjs, same view on every peer) moves me, an ally in contact or a building within 2 hexes to a free hex within 10: the clicked hex (the thing that gains most goes there), the clicked thing (to its best hex), or with no click the most beneficial move. A moved building keeps its look, bonus and hidden trap (world edits moved:/made:). The Empty slot plays as Empty Posture while a tile-taking cast is queued. 1.1.0 (user rulings 2026-11-18): wall tokens (obstacles, labyrinth walls) are movable too; the card stands as a channel permanent (smallest die) that puts a Harmony bonus token (Will point-buy) on my tile every following action until I play A/B/M/EM, emit another element, or stand next to an enemy (stop 'contact'); ∀: the permanent stays when the channel ends and adds the target's stat to mine (an ally's Will, a moved building's stat bonus). World edits are dimension state: every peer keeps a ledger (world_ledger_json, autosaved) so a mover who leaves leaves the map changed.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: One of: me, a living ally in contact, a building within 2 hexes (not a fortress / tree / wall) moves to a free hex 1–10 hexes from me. Clicked thing → it moves to its best hex; clicked free hex → the thing that gains most goes there; no / unusable click → the best (thing, hex) pair. Gain = value(new) − value(old): unit +2 on a building; healthy: −(hexes beyond contact with the nearest seen enemy) − (extra enemies in contact); hurt (life ≤ half): +hexes to the nearest enemy (cap 10); building: +2 per friend within 1, −2 per seen enemy within 1; wall (within 2): +3 per hurt friend it shields (next to it, closer to its nearest enemy). Ties: shorter move, me → ally → building → wall, id, (q, r). game/awake.mjs.
Every action after the cast while the channel stands: a Harmony bonus token on the caster's tile, value = Will point-buy die (a failed roll gives none that action).
∀: the permanent stays and adds the target's stat (ally Will / building stat bonus) to the caster's.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_harmony (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
